items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Somebody told me -- I think it was John [Ralby] told me that while you were over there...

ctx.x: a party at Dexter's house, and they jammed for four days together at different clubs, and two weeks later Ben's dead, two weeks later. And there's -- so that's why I say, he must have had a premonition because he was determined. He was asking everybody about Ben Webster, Ben -- he said, 'I've got to see him while I'm on this trip, while I'm over here.' And good thing he did see him, because if he'd left and didn't see him, he never would have seen him anymore anyway.
Somebody told me -- I think it was John [Ralby] told me that while you were over there (inaudible) you had to go somewhere about 200 miles on a bus or something, and you had to stand all the way.
